utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure, I can take the late shift for the carpool if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Mara. I’m in if you still need me later.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I’ll keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can take the early shift if that helps. Just tell me the pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo. What pickup time should I tell everyone?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: 8:00 works for me.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on the supplies and help sort out the carpool. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, I can handle the carpool stuff. Just remind me what times we’re doing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That works for me. I’m thinking the usual school run times, and I’ll send you the exact schedule so we can line it up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can take the later shift if that helps with the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help, but can you confirm the pickup time first? I need to make sure the schedule still works.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: What time is the pickup? If it’s still after 5, I can make it work.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still on for the school run tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, I think so - I'll double-check and let you know if anything changed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, just let me know once you’ve checked.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the carpool got shuffled a bit this morning. I can ask around and see who’s covering the next run.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Tess. I can lend a hand if you need me to cover a run or move cars around.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Gus. I’ll check who needs the extra hand, and if it looks tight I’ll take you up on moving cars around.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I can ask around and see who’s in for the carpool, then I’ll pass the word along.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That helps. Just tell me who’s in once you hear back, and I’ll keep track of the list.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll do that and let you know as soon as I hear who’s in.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can take the earlier slot tomorrow if that helps, and I’ll let you know by tonight.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm that before tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I’ll confirm tonight and let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sure, I can handle the carpool. What time works best for you?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Morning works for me.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Morning works for me too. I’ll set up the carpool and confirm the pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll do the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, I’ll count on you for it. What time are you planning to start?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll start around 8 and head over then.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the carpool. I may have mixed up the time again, but I can check and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No worries, just let me know when you know the time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, I’ll check and let you know as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can take the first shift if that helps. Just tell me what time you need me there.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That works for me. What time should I plan on being there?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Let’s say around 8:00 — does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sure, I can set up the carpool and send the details around.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, thanks. I can jump in if you need me to.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ll send the invite details and loop you in if I need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can help with the carpool. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m free around 7:30 if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can do Tuesday pickup, but I need to leave by 3:15 for the school run.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That works for me. I can take Wednesday pickup if you handle Monday and Tuesday, and we’ll stay clear of that 3:15 cutoff.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, then I’ll handle Monday and Tuesday and make sure I’m clear of the 3:15 cutoff.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Vik, I can help coordinate the carpool if that makes things easier.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I can help with that. I’ll loop you in and we can figure out the carpool plan together.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good - just send me the details and I’ll help keep everyone on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can help with that carpool.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, but can you make sure the timing works for pickup and drop-off?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yes, I’ll check the pickup and drop-off times so they line up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the carpool location noted down. Where should I be waiting?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: You can wait by the community center entrance on Maple, right by the front steps. I’ll meet you there at 8:15.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, I’ll wait by the community center entrance on Maple at 8:15.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still on for the carpool tomorrow, or did the plan change?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, we're still on. Nothing changed on my end.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, what time should I be ready?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with the carpool schedule.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll handle the route list and keep it updated.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect, I’ll keep an eye on the schedule and help make sure everyone stays in sync.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the carpool might be changing, but I haven't gotten the full details yet. Did Noah say what time we're supposed to be ready?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I think it was around 8, but I might be mixing that up. Let me check with him and I'll tell you.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Okay, thanks for checking. I’ll go by what you hear from him and be ready around 8 unless you tell me otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So Tess, you’re saying the carpool starts tomorrow, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, tomorrow morning. I’ll send over the details in a bit.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, tomorrow morning for sure?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, I can take the later shift if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would help a lot. Thanks, Ira.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course, I’ll handle it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the carpool. I might be mixing up the days, but I’m pretty sure I can take my turn this week.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, just text me the day when you know it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Will do — I’ll text you as soon as I know which day it is.
